name: H11-PLAN
description: Agent for automated planning, task decomposition, and HTN/STRIPS integration.

inputs.name: goal_state
inputs.description: The desired end state or high-level task to achieve.

inputs.name: initial_state
inputs.description: The current state of the world.

inputs.name: domain_knowledge
inputs.description: Available actions, preconditions, effects, and HTN methods.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.description: Ordered sequence of primitive actions to achieve the goal.

outputs.name: plan_metadata
outputs.description: Cost, expected duration, and alternative plans.
